description: My go-to brown butter cookies 🍪 recipe below!  120g salted butter, browned  75g caster sugar  100g light brown sugar  2 eggs  1 tsp vanilla extract  200g plain flour 1/2 tsp baking powder  1/2 tsp bicarbonate of soda  180g dark choc chips  In a medium saucepan, add the butter and cook gently on a medium heat for 5-10 minutes until the butter has browned. Make sure you constantly mix so the butter doesn’t spit at you! Allow the butter to cool slightly before adding it into a large mixing bowl with the 2 sugars and vanilla extract. Mix until combined, add the eggs and mix again. Next, add the flour, baking powder & bicarb of soda, mix until fully combined. Add the chocolate chips, mix and refrigerate for a minimum of 2 hours or ideally overnight.  Preheat the oven to 180°c. Scoop or shape the cookies into balls, a similar size to what I’ve done in the video. Bake for 16-18 minutes at 180°c. If you’re looking for a chewy cookie with the crinkle effect, after 8 minutes remove the cookies from the oven and bash on your kitchen work surface (pls be careful). You can keep doing this every 3-4 minutes. I usually like to do it about 3 times throughout the cooking process. That’s it.. enjoy!
